english: This notice explains the graduate school internal rules of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
Decisions of the department faculty meeting on 1 Apr 2024 (Mon)
ㅇ Graduate thesis qualifying exam (논문제출자격시험, the exam you must pass before you can submit a thesis): oral exam abolished
The oral exam is abolished after the 1st semester of the 2024 academic year (exam held in March 2024). (Pass or fail will be decided by the written exam.)
ㅇ Composition of the graduate thesis review committee (the committee that evaluates your degree thesis)
When selecting thesis review committee members, you must include a faculty member of the SNU Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
